concepts.def: Demographic Transition Model; 5 stages from high BR+DR to low BR+DR.
Births per 1000 per year (crude birth rate).
Deaths per 1000 per year (crude death rate).
Birth rate minus death rate; population growth rate.
Average births per woman; replacement level 2.1.
Possible decline phase; deaths exceed births (Japan, Italy).

walkthroughs.body_html: Stage 1: high stationary (BR 35-50, DR 30-40); pre-industrial. Stage 2: early expanding; DR falls first as medicine improves. Stage 3: late expanding; BR falls as urbanisation/education spread. Stage 4: low stationary (BR 10-15, DR 9-12). Stage 5: declining (BR < DR).

UK Stage 1 to 1750; Stage 2 1750-1880 with Industrial Revolution; Stage 3 1880-1940 with sanitation and education; Stage 4 by 1950. Currently Stage 4-5: BR 10.5/1000, DR 9.5/1000 (2022). TFR 1.49 below replacement. Net migration sustains population.

Niger BR 47/1000 (highest globally), DR 8/1000 in 2022. TFR 6.7 children per woman. Median age 14.8 years; 50 percent of population under 15. Drivers: low female education, religious values, agricultural economy, polygyny. Population to triple by 2050.
